name: Alcohol-free month
summary: Take a month off alcohol with a night-by-night plan, drink swaps and scripts for social events.

onboarding.prompt: When does your alcohol-free month start?
onboarding.reaction: Day one is on the calendar.

onboarding.prompt: Which nights do you usually drink?
onboarding.reaction: Thanks. Those nights get extra support.

onboarding.prompt: Any social events coming up this month?
onboarding.reaction: We'll write you an easy script for each one.
Great picks. We'll stock the plan with them.

onboarding.prompt: Tap the time of evening you'd like a check-in nudge.
onboarding.reaction: Nudge set for your usual drinking nights.

phases.name: First week
actions: Talk to your doctor before starting if you drink daily or heavily
Evening swap on usual drinking nights
Remove or move alcohol at home

phases.name: Middle stretch
benchmarks: Alcohol-free through at least one social event
actions: Event scripts ready a day ahead
Weekly reflection on sleep, mood and money kept

phases.name: Finish and decide
actions: Choose: keep going, cut back, or return with a plan

plan_blueprint.calendar: An evening check-in on usual drinking nights, a script reminder the day before each social event, and a day-30 reflection.

approach_variants.habit: A new evening ritual replaces the drink at the same time each night; alcohol-free streak.
approach_variants.willpower: 30-day countdown with a partner dare for the toughest weekend.
approach_variants.time: Evenings planned as calendar blocks with an activity in each.
approach_variants.reward: Money not spent on drinks set aside toward an owner-chosen reward.
approach_variants.resource: First days stock swaps, plan who to tell, and save support line numbers.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
If you drink daily or heavily, stopping suddenly can be unsafe. Get medical advice first rather than stopping on your own.
If you're struggling, contact your doctor or a local support line. GoalKin is not a treatment program.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A drink doesn't end the month. The plan logs it privately, asks what made that night hard, adds support for similar nights, and the count continues from the next day.
addon_tracks: Suggested: Mocktail and Swap Recipe Pack
